opening.argument: The message pairs a direct invitation to join Forsage with unusually large short-term income claims. It describes a return of “5-5.5 Lakh rupees” in two weeks, alongside the stated monthly amount of 5,000 to 7,000, and directs viewers to “go and join him” based on a person's status. The title reinforces that recruitment pitch by urging viewers to “join fast.” Taken together, the income claims and person-mediated invitation present joining as a way to earn, not as commentary or investigation. The evidence does not establish what any viewer actually earned, but it shows a recruitment-oriented solicitation built around substantial earnings claims.
